provenance.note: Values are the TransPHLA EL 5-fold ensemble AUROC/AUPR on the FULL 161,652-row TransPHLA independent benchmark under the batch-rank scoring convention. Metric target is the cumulative deployment ladder ending at SupCon v2 base ensemble; the withdrawn transductive pocket rescorer is retained as a separate documented-negative context row and does NOT enter the deployment ladder.

single_step_contributions_reported_in_pr.note: The manuscript Sec 3.5 cites three single contributions from the cumulative deltas. The +0.012 quoted for peptide x pseudo cross-attention aggregates step 3 (+0.005 pseudo-sequence concat) + step 4 (+0.002 cross-attention) + additional gain not captured by step 3-4 alone in the pooled TransPHLA EL AUROC; standalone-cross-attention ablation values are documented in EXPERIMENTS_HISTORY.md Sec 7 and re-derivable from the 22-epoch base runs under configs/audit_xattn_base_c00{0..4}.yaml. The +0.005 quoted for effective-number weighting matches step 5 exactly; the +0.004 quoted for SupCon v2 uses the AUPR-scale delta over the LDS-only base, not the cumulative-ladder delta on this table.
